# Workshop Code

Run the complete lab in R or RStudio, or follow the [guided Workshop page](workshop.html).
The examples use the October 14 seven-year datasets and no adjustment covariates.

| File | Contents |
|---|---|
| [Complete R script](code/workshop_lab.R) | Import, descriptive statistics, plots, TWFE, CSA, manual Simple ATT, and optional extended TWFE and event study. |
| [R Markdown source](workshop.Rmd) | The explanations and executable code that produce the Workshop page. |

[Install the packages](workshop.html#setup) before the session. The script loads local
CSV files when present and otherwise downloads them from this website. All models
and plots use `outcome_raw`; standard errors account for clustering by district.

The optional extended-TWFE and event-study sections can be explored after the
30-minute lab. The page includes the R/package versions used for the displayed results.
